name: Endpoint-Interpolating B-spline MRA
aliases: B-spline MRA with multiple knots at endpoints
B-spline boundary handling via multiple knots
definition: A multi-resolution analysis on the bounded interval L^2[0,1] using B-splines with multiple knots at the endpoints to handle boundaries without artificial discontinuities.
summary: Endpoint-Interpolating B-spline MRA constructs multiresolution bases on bounded intervals using multiple endpoint knots to eliminate artificial discontinuities while preserving local support.
